@use "sass:math";
$breakpoints: (sm: 576px, md: 768px);
// .commented { }
%visually-hidden { position: absolute; }
@function rem($px) { @return math.div($px, 16px) * 1rem; }
@mixin respond($bp) {
  @media (min-width: map-get($breakpoints, $bp)) { @content; }
}
.card {
  $pad: 8px;
  padding: $pad;
  @extend %visually-hidden;
  &__title { font-size: rem(18px); }
  &:hover, &.is-active { color: red; }
  .icon + & { margin: 0; }
  @include respond(md) { padding: $pad * 2; }
  #{$self}--wide { width: 100%; }
}
@each $name, $size in $breakpoints {
  .w-#{$name} { width: $size; }
}
